sources.entry: Purr - Open-source on-device dictation that types into any app with Parakeet or Whisper, plus meeting notes with speaker labels and summaries. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/iamarunbrahma/purr) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: Purr
summary.one_liner: Purr is a free, open-source, on-device dictation app for Mac that types your speech into any text field, with optional meeting notes and voice editing.
use_cases: dictate messages and emails into any Mac app
take meeting notes with speaker labels without a bot
private transcription without sending audio to a server
summary.what_it_does: Purr runs in the Mac menu bar. You hold a hotkey (Right Option by default, configurable), speak, and release, and the words are typed into whichever text field has focus. Smart Typing shows text while you are still talking, available for English with the default Parakeet engine. A meeting notetaker records microphone and Mac audio together, labels speakers, and can write summaries in 28 languages. Voice Edit lets you select text, hold ⌃⌥ E, and speak a change, rewritten by Apple Intelligence or Gemma on the Mac. Transcription runs on the Apple Neural Engine, with Whisper available as an alternative engine for about 100 languages.
notable: Fully on-device transcription with no telemetry; voice never sent to a server
Meeting notes that work without a bot and label speakers
Voice Edit rewrites selected text from spoken instructions
caveats: Requires macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon; meeting system audio needs macOS 14.2 or later
Smart Typing and streaming are English only; Whisper cannot type while you talk
Model downloads are large (Parakeet about 450 MB, Gemma 4 E2B 3.35 GB) and some features need extra downloads
Voice Edit cannot read selections in some web pages and Electron apps
